metadata.title: Retro Glamour Portrait with Radiating Background

recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body studio portrait of a man in a white jumpsuit, positioned against a metallic, radiating sunburst background. The aesthetic is heavily influenced by 1970s glam rock, featuring high-contrast lighting and a prominent, stylized script logo.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's white attire contrasts sharply with the dark, textured floor and the metallic background.
The radiating lines of the background converge behind the subject's head, creating a halo effect.
The script typography is placed in the negative space to the left, balanced by the subject's lean to the right.
coreInvariants: Radiating sunburst pattern in the background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body figure positioned on the right third of the frame, leaning slightly inward.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bold script logo on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the face, follow the body down, move across the dark floor, and up through the script logo back to the radiating background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large open area on the left side, utilized for the primary typographic element.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white and silver-grey tones dominate the subject and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal or black for the floor and the typography outline.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Subtle warm skin tones and dark hair provide the only organic color variance.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the white clothing and the dark shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to monochromatic silver, white, and black with natural skin tones.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Round, upright script with connected lowercase letters.
letterConstructionRules: High-contrast stroke weight between thick downstrokes and thin connectors.
Large, looping flourishes on the initial capital letter.
Terminal of the final letter extends into a long, underlining swash.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The dot on the 'i' is a perfect circle.
The tail of the 'g' loops back to connect with the following vowel.

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed in the bright negative space of the background.

treatment.shadow: Hard black drop shadow, offset down and right

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stand-alone display script; if secondary text is needed, use a clean, wide-set sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary underline swash and bold weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a man with long dark hair wearing a 1970s white high-collared jumpsuit, standing on a dark floor. The background consists of silver metallic panels radiating outwards from behind his head. 35mm film grain, high contrast.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold, white script word in the center-left area. The text must have a thick black outline and a hard black drop shadow. The final letter should have a long swash that underlines the word.

verificationChecks: Is the background radiating from a central point?
Does the text have a distinct black outline and shadow?
Is the subject wearing a monochromatic white outfit?
Is the composition balanced between the subject on the right and text on the left?

mustRedesign: The exact facial features of the individual
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the radiating lines do not look like modern digital vectors but textured panels.
Check that the white jumpsuit maintains detail in the highlights.
Verify the drop shadow on the text is consistent with the 70s graphic style.
Confirm the subject's hair and clothing reflect the specific glam-rock era.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + radiating metallic background + bold outlined script + 1970s film aesthetic.
